messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: saving map
parts:
One way is to use replace.map to add it to your cross and then pull.map with as.table=TRUE to make a tabular version of the map. Then write.csv to write to a comma-delimited file.

  mycross <- replace.map(mycross, mymap)
  mymapAsTable <- pull.map(mymap, as.table=TRUE)
  write.csv(mymapAsTable, file="mymap.csv")

karl
